content.name: Show Me More Trade Offers
content.author: Chem O`Dun
content.description:
A handy Quality-of-life mod that lets you see more trade offers at once in Map mode...
[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2] [list] [*] Simply expand a maximum number of trade offers shown in Map mode from default [b]5[/b] to [b]50[/b]. [/list] [h2][b]Limitations[/b][/h2] [list] [*] Available only from game version [b]8.00HF3[/b] and newer, due to reliance on the latest version of the [b]UI Extensions and HUD[/b] mod. [*] Version of the [b]UI Extensions and HUD[/b] mod by [b]kuertee[/b] must be [b]8.035[/b] or newer. It is required to have access to trade layer settings. [/list] [h2][b]Requirements[/b][/h2] [list] [*] [b]X4: Foundations[/b] 8.00HF3 or newer. [*] [b]UI Extensions and HUD[/b] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/kuertee?gameId=2659]kuertee[/url] to be installed and enabled. Version [b]8.035[/b] and upper is required. [list] [*] It is available only via the Nexus Mods - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/552]UI Extensions and HUD[/url] [/list] [*] [b]Mod Support APIs[/b] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sirnukes?gameId=2659]SirNukes[/url] to be installed and enabled. Version [b]1.95[/b] and upper is required. [list] [*] It is available via Steam - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2042901274]SirNukes Mod Support APIs[/url] [*] Or via the Nexus Mods - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/503]Mod Support APIs[/url] [/list] [/list] [h2][b]Installation[/b][/h2] [list] [*] You can download the latest version via Steam client - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3624666582]Show Me More Trade Offers[/url] [list] [*] Due to absence the [b]UI Extensions and HUD[/b] mod on Steam and some limitations of Steam Workshop please be sure that you have installed and enabled the [b]UI Extensions and HUD[/b] mod by [b]kuertee[/b] of version [b]8.035[/b] or newer. [/list] [*] Or you can do it via the Nexus Mods - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/1910]Show Me More Trade Offers[/url] [/list] [h2][b]Usage[/b][/h2]
No special actions required. Just open the Map mode and then edit maximum number of trade offers shown in Trade Filters menu/panel. [list] [*] Trade offers limited by default maximum value: [/list] [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-ShowMeMoreTradeOffers/refs/heads/main/docs/images/trade_offers_with_default_maximum_value.png[/img] [list][*] Trade Filters menu with updated maximum value: [/list] [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-ShowMeMoreTradeOffers/refs/heads/main/docs/images/trade_filters_with_updated_maximum_value.png[/img] [list][*] Trade offers are restricted to a suitable value, though not the maximum: [/list] [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-ShowMeMoreTradeOffers/refs/heads/main/docs/images/trade_offers_with_new_value.png[/img]
[h2][b]Video[/b][/h2]
Video demonstration of the Version 1.00 [previewyoutube=ml6-xKt50QA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Credits[/b][/h2] [list] [*] Author: Chem O`Dun, on [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ChemODun/mods?gameId=2659]Nexus Mods[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/chemodun/myworkshopfiles/?appid=392160]Steam Workshop[/url] [*] [i]"X4: Foundations"[/i] is a trademark of [url=https://www.egosoft.com]Egosoft[/url]. [/list] [h2][b]Acknowledgements[/b][/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://www.egosoft.com]EGOSOFT[/url] — for the X series. [*] [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sirnukes?gameId=2659]SirNukes[/url] — for the [b]Mod Support APIs[/b] that power the UI hooks. [*] [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/kuertee?gameId=2659]kuertee[/url] — for his exciting [b]UI Extensions and HUD[/b] that makes this extension possible. [*] [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Forleyor?gameId=2659]Forleyor[/url] — for his constant help with understanding the UI modding! [/list]
